news.title: Manfred says MLB owners won't OK deal without cap as lockout looms
news.summary: Commissioner Rob Manfred said owners will not accept any deal without a salary cap, leaving MLB on track for a lockout that could threaten the 2027 season.

news.title: Sources: Mets considered Skubal front-runner as teams ramp up pursuit of ace lefty
news.summary: Tarik Skubal has met with multiple teams that are expected to pursue him, but the Mets are considered the favorite to land the star pitcher, sources told ESPN.
